about: A cell's value as Blazor's ExGrid sends it to the Script Core (ADR-0350 sections 7 and 16): what ExGrid.Components.ScriptValues writes for a .NET value, and what the bridge (packages/blazor/src/wire-values.ts) reads the same JSON as. A case with `dotnet` and `wire` holds on the C# side; one with `wire` and `reads` on the bridge's; one with both is the contract end to end. `refused` names what C# refuses to send (`notSupported`) or the bridge refuses to read (`argument`).
